name: engage-site
description: Lean Engage install. Downloads the release named in engage.config.json; nothing else lives here.

ENGAGE_SECRET.description: Optional. Generated automatically on the first build; only set it to use your own value.

INTERNAL_ROUTE_KEY.description: Optional. Generated automatically on the first build; only set it to use your own value.

SITE_URL.description: Public site URL, e.g. https://your-domain.example. Used for sitemap.xml, robots.txt and canonical/OG URLs.

STRIPE_SECRET_KEY.description: Stripe secret key. Leave unset to deploy with the Shop feature off.

STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY.description: Stripe publishable key. Leave unset to deploy with the Shop feature off.

STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET.description: Stripe webhook signing secret. Leave unset to deploy with the Shop feature off.

NEXT_PUBLIC_STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY.description: Same value as STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY, exposed to the browser. Leave unset to deploy with the Shop feature off.

ENGAGE_LOG_LEVEL.description: Optional: debug | info | warn | error. Defaults to info in production.

UPDATE_REPO.description: This site's own GitHub repository (owner/name, the one the Deploy button created). Lets the admin update with one click. Optional.

UPDATE_GITHUB_TOKEN.description: Fine-grained GitHub token limited to that repository with Contents read and write. Optional; without it, update by retrying the build in Cloudflare.

ENGAGE_SOURCE_TOKEN.description: Only if the Engage source repository is private: a token with read access to it. Leave empty otherwise.
